INTEGRATED SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory Safety.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory Safety.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory Safety.

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory apparatus and instruments? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory apparatus and instruments.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Integrated Science? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Integrated Science.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Integrated Science.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Integrated Science.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Integrated Science.

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetism? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Magnetism.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Magnetism.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetism.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Magnetism.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.

19. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids, Bases and Indicators? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids, Bases and Indicators.

21. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
22. In three clear sentences, explain Acids, Bases and Indicators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Human Reproductive System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Human Excretory System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Magnetism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Integrated Science and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
